title: How Does a Leader Know If They Have Followership Skills?
author: Admired Leadership
summary: The author contends that great leadership is not only about extraordinary results but about creating followership, the credibility, respect, and trust that make performance sustainable. Rare leaders who have this skill can be spotted by how team members behave around them and how they feel about themselves in the leader's presence. The piece lists observable signs, including deep loyalty, willingness to follow the leader to a new job, requests for personal advice, acceptance of change, and extra effort. It closes by tracing the skill to listening, validating, including, and making others feel special.
points: Followership is the other side of the leadership coin and the source of credibility, respect, and trust.
The clearest signal is how team members feel about themselves around the leader: more confident because the leader believes in them.
Observable signs include team members seeking personal advice, accepting changes that affect them, volunteering to help with hard tasks, and being willing to follow the leader elsewhere.
The underlying skills are listening to, validating, including, and making others feel special.
quotes: Creating followership is the other side of the leadership coin. Without it, leaders won’t find the ultimate prize of credibility, respect, and trust necessary for sustainable performance.
Team members don’t just feel differently when interacting with a followership leader. They feel differently about themselves.
The belief such a leader has in them produces a boost of confidence they rarely experience. Not surprisingly, they want to be around a leader who makes them feel that way.
Over time, their sense of connection to a followership leader is so strong that they would do anything for them. Expressions like “run through walls” come to mind.
Followership leaders receive offers to help with their most difficult tasks. These team members will go the extra mile with any assignment.
The skills of followership are worth the effort for any leader to master. Results are so much bigger and more sustainable with a heavy dose of followership.
